claims.content: To decompress the contents of a selected archive into a folder on the computer system.

goal.raw_text: To decompress the contents of a selected archive into a folder on the computer system.

claims.content: The user has access to a computer system with PeaZip installed or running as a standalone application.
An archive file exists on the computer system that is in a format supported by PeaZip for extraction.
If the archive is encrypted (locked), the user must possess the correct password and/or keyfile required for decryption.
The user selects one or more archive files that have a suitable format for decompression and initiates the extraction process.

trigger.raw_text: The user selects one or more archive files that have a suitable format for decompression and initiates the extraction process.

claims.content: By selecting one or more archives that have suitable format for decompression and extraction of their content from file manager interface, clicking the right button of the mouse of the computer system(or the equivalent button of the equivalent input device that the computer system may have)and then choosing "Extract" or "Extract(in new folder)".
By pressing the button writing "Browser" on it, in file manager interface and then selecting "Go to extraction layout" from the submenu that appears.

By selecting one or more archives that have suitable format for decompression and extraction of their content from some area of the computer system(outside of the applications graphical environment), clicking the right button of the mouse of the computer system (or the equivalent button of the equivalent input device that the computer system may have)and then choosing "Extract", "Extract here" or "Extract here(in new folder)" from "Send to" menu.
The archive's contents are extracted to a folder on the computer system.
The original archive file remains unchanged (neither destroyed nor deleted).
The extracted files retain their original content and name, saved at the same location as the archive unless otherwise specified by the user.
